//: Grafana dashboard, committed and provisioned rather than hand-built in the UI — same discipline as simple-infra keeping promtail.yaml.template in-repo instead of only on a host. Datasource is the existing Grafana Cloud Loki (eu-metrics-loki.livepeer.live); there is no metrics backend in this stack and none is needed, because a probe result is an event and LogQL aggregates events natively.

list.//: Turns a latency step change from a mystery into 'kilout added 3 capabilities that morning'. This is the context nobody reconstructs later.
list.name: Fleet changes

panels.//: Denominator is attributable outcomes only — payment_rejected and platform_error are excluded so a platform fault does not read as a fleet outage.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({role="loadtest"} | json | evt="probe" | outcome="ok" [24h])) / sum(count_over_time({role="loadtest"} | json | evt="probe" | outcome!~"payment_rejected|platform_error|skipped" [24h]))

panels.title: Fleet success rate (24h)

panels.//: Deliberately prominent. If this drops below 1.0 the run bought data it cannot use, and that must be as visible as a failure.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({role="loadtest"} | json | evt="probe" | attr="confirmed" [24h])) / sum(count_over_time({role="loadtest"} | json | evt="probe" [24h]))

panels.title: Attribution coverage

panels.//: Backs the dead-man's switch: a dead VM must not look like a healthy fleet.
panels.title: Hours since last completed round

targets.expr: sum by (orch) (count_over_time({role="loadtest", orch=~"$orch"} | json | evt="probe" | outcome="ok" [24h])) / sum by (orch) (count_over_time({role="loadtest", orch=~"$orch"} | json | evt="probe" | outcome!~"payment_rejected|platform_error|skipped" [24h]))

panels.//: p50, not p95: at a few probes per capability per day a p95 is essentially the second-worst observation and would be an alarm generator.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {role="loadtest", orch=~"$orch"} | json | evt="probe" | outcome="ok" | unwrap ms [6h]) by (orch)

panels.title: p50 latency by orchestrator

panels.//: max is the honest tail at low sample counts, where a p95 is not supportable.

targets.expr: max_over_time({role="loadtest", orch=~"$orch"} | json | evt="probe" | outcome="ok" | unwrap ms [24h]) by (orch)

panels.title: Worst observed latency (24h)

panels.//: The allocator distributes MEASUREMENT and lets dollars follow; this is where a dollar split that looks unfair in practice would become visible before anyone builds a fee-fairness mechanism for it.

targets.expr: sum by (orch) (sum_over_time({role="loadtest", orch=~"$orch"} | json | evt="probe" | unwrap usd [24h]))

panels.title: Spend by orchestrator vs fair share

targets.expr: sum by (orch, outcome) (count_over_time({role="loadtest", orch=~"$orch"} | json | evt="probe" | outcome!~"ok|skipped" [24h]))

panels.//: 20 attempts is the demotion threshold; below it no decision can be made, and that must be visible rather than silent.
panels.title: Samples in the 7-day window (is each node judgeable?)

panels.//: Without this, 'no data for slack-send-file' is indistinguishable from a broken probe and someone re-adds it next quarter.
panels.title: Excluded capabilities (never probed)

title: Community Orchestrators — Probe Health
